proof_body:
by
  intro A B C D h
  have hC : C = B + D - A := by
    rw [vsub_eq_sub, vsub_eq_sub] at h
    calc C = (C - D) + D := by abel
      _ = (B - A) + D := by rw [h]
      _ = B + D - A := by abel
  subst hC
  let S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 1
  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hSv : MeasureTheory.volume S = 1 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc]
    simp
  let T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) := {x | (0 ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ 1) ∧ (0 ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ 1)}
  have hTv : MeasureTheory.volume T = 1 := by
    have mp := (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).comp (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 2))
    have := mp.measure_preimage hSm.nullMeasurableSet
    rw [hSv] at this
    exact this
  have hTc : Convex ℝ T := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    simp only [T, Set.mem_setOf_eq, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hx hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨⟨h5, h6⟩, h7, h8⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨⟨by positivity, by nlinarith⟩, by positivity, by nlinarith⟩
  set u := B - A with hu
  set w := D - A with hw
  let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x 0 • u + x 1 • w
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        simp only [PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
        abel
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, smul_add, RingHom.id_apply] }
  have hL : ∀ x, L x = x 0 • u + x 1 • w := fun _ => rfl
  have hdet : LinearMap.det L = u 0 * w 1 - u 1 * w 0 := by
    rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis L, Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, hL]
    ring
  have hhull : convexHull ℝ ({A, B, B + D - A, D} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) = (fun y => y + A) '' (L '' T) := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · apply convexHull_min
      · intro p hp
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨0, ⟨0, by simp [T], by simp⟩, by simp⟩
        · refine ⟨u, ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, by simp [T], by simp [hL]⟩, by simp [hu]⟩
        · refine ⟨u + w, ⟨!₂[1, 1], by simp [T], by simp [hL]⟩, ?_⟩
          simp only [hu, hw]
          abel
        · refine ⟨w, ⟨EuclideanSpace.single 1 1, by simp [T], by simp [hL]⟩, by simp [hw]⟩
      · have := (hTc.linear_image L).translate A
        convert this using 1
        ext y
        simp [add_comm]
    · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have hc := convex_convexHull ℝ ({A, B, B + D - A, D} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      have := hc.sum_mem (t := Finset.univ) (w := ![(1 - x 0) * (1 - x 1), x 0 * (1 - x 1), x 0 * x 1, (1 - x 0) * x 1])
        (z := ![A, B, B + D - A, D])
        (by
          intro i _
          fin_cases i <;> simp <;> apply mul_nonneg <;> linarith)
        (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_four]; ring)
        (by
          intro i _
          apply subset_convexHull
          fin_cases i <;> simp)
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at this
      convert this using 1
      simp [hL, hu, hw]
      module
  rw [hhull, Set.image_add_right, MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add_right,
    MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hTv, hdet, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _)]
  have hsin := InnerProductGeometry.sin_angle_mul_norm_mul_norm u w
  have inn : ∀ U W : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), inner ℝ U W = U 0 * W 0 + U 1 * W 1 := by
    intro U W
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  rw [inn, inn, inn,
    show (u 0 * u 0 + u 1 * u 1) * (w 0 * w 0 + w 1 * w 1) - (u 0 * w 0 + u 1 * w 1) * (u 0 * w 0 + u 1 * w 1) =
      (u 0 * w 1 - u 1 * w 0) ^ 2 by ring, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs] at hsin
  rw [← hsin, dist_comm A B, dist_comm A D, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, EuclideanGeometry.angle]
  simp only [vsub_eq_sub, ENNReal.toReal_one]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (A B C D : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), B -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ D → (MeasureTheory.volume (convexHull ℝ ({A, B, C, D} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))))).toReal = dist A B * dist A D * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D)
